about.visionMissionSub: The foundation that guides every step of our service to the Muslim community.
about.visionText: To become an exemplary mosque that is prosperous and independent, and a center of civilization for the ummah that brings blessings to the universe.
missionItems: Conducting obligatory and voluntary worship with comfort and devotion.
Providing comprehensive Islamic education for all levels.
Empowering the community's economy through transparent ZISWAF management.
Building a Quranic generation with noble character and broad insight.
about.profileDesc1: Al-Ikhlas Mosque is a grand mosque located at Jl. Kebayoran Lama No. 12, South Jakarta. Established in 1975 with a spirit of mutual cooperation, this mosque has developed into a center for religious activities, education, and social services for the surrounding community.
about.profileDesc2: With a building area of 2,400 m² on a 3,000 m² plot, the mosque can accommodate more than 1,200 worshippers. Various flagship programs have been consistently implemented, ranging from Islamic studies, Qur'an memorization, social assistance, to community economic empowerment through ZISWAF.
about.contactAddress: Jl. Kebayoran Lama No. 12, South Jakarta
about.timelineSub: Nearly five decades of dedicated service to the Muslim community.

timeline.title: Mosque Establishment
timeline.desc: Al-Ikhlas Mosque was established by local community leaders with spirit of mutual cooperation and community contribution.

timeline.title: First Renovation
timeline.desc: The main building was expanded to accommodate the growing congregation up to 500 people.

timeline.title: Tower Construction
timeline.desc: A 30-meter high tower was built as a landmark and symbol of Islamic grandeur in the area.

timeline.title: Major Renovation
timeline.desc: Comprehensive renovation with modern-Islamic architecture, addition of library, classrooms, and modern facilities.

timeline.title: SIMAS Digital System
timeline.desc: Implementation of digital mosque management system (SIMAS) for financial transparency and congregation services.

about.facilitiesSub: We continue to improve facilities for the comfort of all worshippers.
